provenance.source_quote: testing next with a 4CH setup, adding the 4K rear cam and 3K cabin cam. i'll send card scans in a bit. here's some power draw figures. same hardwire cable, cloud off, 12.6v. rear cam firmware: 9.0.0.17 driving recording: 964 mA timelapse parking mode: 632 mA collision detection parking mode (idle): not yet recorded collision detection parking mode (recording): not yet recorded

scope: Separate owner-confirmed installed 4CH front/telephoto/rear/cabin configuration; rear 4K and cabin 3K are owner-declared, not card-scan measurements. Same DC009 hardwire cable explicitly inherited from preceding 2CH test; cloud off; 12.6 V. Rear firmware only: 9.0.0.17; main unit, front, telephoto and cabin firmware unknown. Current is source-reported; watts derived exactly with Decimal as 12.6 V × mA / 1000. Active parking views not separately established. Both collision states are pending, not zero or measured. Card scans promised but not received for this cohort; no new bitrate, playback FPS, capture cadence, timing, HDR or quality evidence. Earlier 2CH/video cohorts remain separate.
derivation: power_w = Decimal(voltage_v) * Decimal(current_ma) / Decimal(1000); source supplies current, not watts.
